trackCatalog.name: How Much of That Life Is There?

lyrics_aligned.ru: Тик-так, мои часы отстали после того самого лета.
lyrics_aligned.en: Tick-tock, my watch fell behind after that very summer.

lyrics_aligned.ru: Я ношу в кармане запах моря, привезенный с другого конца света.
lyrics_aligned.en: I carry in my pocket the scent of the sea, brought from the other end of the world.
And I am just a paper airplane,
Tilting in the gust of wind,

lyrics_aligned.ru: Я лечу туда, где все незнакомо,
lyrics_aligned.en: I fly to where everything is unfamiliar,
Knowing no answers.
And I am a paper airplane,
Tilting in the wind,

lyrics_aligned.ru: Я лечу туда, где все незнакомо,
lyrics_aligned.en: I fly to where everything is unfamiliar,
Knowing no answers.

lyrics_aligned.ru: А кто-то летит на север, а кто-то навстречу рассвету.
lyrics_aligned.en: And someone flies to the north, and someone toward the sunrise.

lyrics_aligned.ru: Кому-то достаточно малого, кому-то мало планеты.
lyrics_aligned.en: For someone the small is enough, for someone the planet is too small.
And I am just a paper airplane,
Tilting in the gust of wind,

lyrics_aligned.ru: Я лечу туда, где все незнакомо,
lyrics_aligned.en: I fly to where everything is unfamiliar,
Knowing no answers.
And I am a paper airplane,
Tilting in the wind,

lyrics_aligned.ru: Я лечу туда, где все незнакомо,
lyrics_aligned.en: I fly to where everything is unfamiliar,
Knowing no answers.
In my pocket is a bit of the past:
The scent of the sea, the warmth of a voice,
And ahead is the unfamiliar new
And the runway.
The runway...
And I am just a paper airplane,
Tilting in the gust of wind,

lyrics_aligned.ru: Я лечу туда, где все незнакомо,
lyrics_aligned.en: I fly to where everything is unfamiliar,
Knowing no answers.
And I am a paper airplane,
Tilting in the wind,

lyrics_aligned.ru: Я лечу туда, где все незнакомо,
lyrics_aligned.en: I fly to where everything is unfamiliar,
Knowing no answers.
Knowing no answers.
We all choose our own path,
Not knowing what lies ahead,
And even losing our route,
We continue to fly.
And we continue to walk.
And we continue to walk.
My fear is shrouded in fog:
One step forward, two steps back.

lyrics_aligned.ru: Не могу, не могу, но хочу, хочу, хочу, хочу, хочу.
lyrics_aligned.en: I can't, I can't, but I want to, I want, I want, I want, I want.
Just a little bit of brave water
Give me a sip to drink:
To bring back strength, to soothe the pain,
Just for a moment, for an inhale.
Just a little bit of brave water
Give me a sip to drink:
To bring back strength, to soothe the pain,

lyrics_aligned.ru: Только на миг, на вдох, на вдох, на вдох.
lyrics_aligned.en: Just for a moment, for an inhale, for an inhale, for an inhale.
The voice trembles like glass.
The heart pounds like an engine.

lyrics_aligned.ru: Всего глоток — и не будет преград.
lyrics_aligned.en: Just one sip — and there will be no barriers.
Simple, but oh so difficult.
Just a little bit of brave water
Give me a sip to drink:
To bring back strength, to soothe the pain,
Just for a moment, for an inhale.

lyrics_aligned.ru: Храброй водицы чуть-чуть дай мне испить глоток.
lyrics_aligned.en: Just a little bit of brave water, give me a sip to drink.
Just a little bit of brave water
Give me a sip to drink:
To bring back strength, to soothe the pain,
Just for a moment, for an inhale.

lyrics_aligned.ru: А знаешь, что я тебе скажу?
lyrics_aligned.en: You know what I will tell you?
Let's dance this life, ah!
Let's not look back,
Let's just rejoice
In every moment, in every day.
Once again, don't let go.
Do you hear how the wind shouts: come on!
Let's dance this life!
Ah, let's dance this life!
Ah, let's dance this life!

lyrics_aligned.ru: Отпускаем заботы, и грусть, и печаль.
lyrics_aligned.en: We let go of worries, and sadness, and sorrow.

lyrics_aligned.ru: Мы тут и живы — не счастье ли это?
lyrics_aligned.en: We are here and alive — isn't that happiness?
Once again, don't let go.
Do you hear how the wind shouts: come on!
Let's dance this life!
Ah, let's dance this life!
Ah, let's dance this life!
Let it all pass.
We are not alone.

lyrics_aligned.ru: Держи мою ладонь и отпусти все, что болит.
lyrics_aligned.en: Hold my palm and let go of everything that hurts.
Let's dance this life!
Ah, let's dance this life!
Ah, let's dance this life!
Let's dance this life!
Let's dance this life.
